title: The corridor of doors
goals: Walk to the tunnel's mouth, cell (15, 3).
Open the map with its word.
starting_code:
# Walk right to the tunnel's column with `move_right`.

# Walk up to its mouth with `move_up`.
hints: Look at the map: we are at (1, 12) and want to go to (15, 3). How much does each number change?
From 1 to 15 is fourteen steps to the right. From 12 to 3 is nine steps up!
intro: Look at all these doors... {mate} says the tunnel is at the end of this corridor! We are standing on cell (1, 12). The map says the tunnel's mouth is cell (15, 3). There's no mark to guide us, so count how much each number changes!
outro: We did it! The magic of the tunnel hides us from sight, but we are inside.
learned: Now you know how to read two cells on the plan and count what changes in each number.
